text: Figure 4.18: DataTypes Overview An ApplicationDataT ype can be composed (in form of a record or an array) of ele- ments, which themselves are typed by another ApplicationDataT ype. This is expressed by the meta-class ApplicationCompositeElementDataPrototype, which is shown in Fig- ure 4.18 for completeness. An ImplementationDataT ype can be composed too, but in this case, no type/prototype concept has been applied.
